mainText: Hello, Verona! At 8 PM, here is today's balanced dish: it is 43 degrees with clear skies at Verona Community Park, and we have a beautiful First Quarter moon. The ISS will soar overhead at 5:39 AM, rising over Mount Horeb and moving toward the Fitchburg and Madison area, reaching high in the sky. Looking ahead, we have an overnight low of 35 degrees with no rain predicted.

In city news, the Verona Police arrested a school bus driver for operating while impaired on Thursday, October 15th, after reports of dangerous driving. Also, remember that the City has new zoning and sign ordinances, and you can check your voting status or find your polling place via the city website.

There is plenty to do, starting with live music at Bailey's Run Vineyard and the Wisconsin Brewing Company today. Tomorrow, you can catch the Dane County Farmer's Market or live music at Paddy Mac's, and mark your calendars for trivia starting next week.
On Thursday, October 15th, the Verona Police Department arrested a school bus driver for operating while impaired; fortunately, no students were injured during the incident.
Today's flavor of the day is the delicious OREO REESE'S Cheesecake. The store is currently open and will remain open until 10:30 PM, so stop by and enjoy a scoop.
